title: The first Renegade settlements
summary: How Renegades built homes before the Necropoli.

claims.text: Early Renegades turned from Stygia, cut shelters from the Tempest near the fallen city, and built forts from soulstuff taken from its ruins.

Villages burned by barbarian tribes in Europe reappeared in the Shadowlands, and Renegade scouts claimed some of these relic hamlets before Charon's Legions could; Renegade towns stood on the borders long before the Necropoli.

title: Thrall runners
summary: Renegades who trade in freed wraiths.

claims.text: Some gangs raid shipments of captured wraiths, sell them as thralls more cheaply than the Hierarchy does, and pay off patrols with part of the oboli.
They still call themselves Renegades, pointing to the captives they set free, especially those who can pay for their chains to be cut.

title: The Newark Skinnies
summary: A daredevil Renegade club that defies the ban on touching the living.

claims.text: GNSA recruits have to prove themselves with an outrageous stunt, such as possessing a NASCAR driver on the last lap or Skinriding the US President during the State of the Union.

Members campaign against the Dictum Mortuum's ban on dealings with the living; the group seems devoted to pleasures of the flesh, but is said to serve a Puppeteer plan to weaken the Shroud and the Hierarchy.

title: Renegades and mediums
summary: Why Renegades argue over the living who can hear the dead.

claims.text: The Hierarchy forbids contact with mediums; some Renegades hate mediums who pry into their Haunts, while others use them to send word to agents among the living or see teaching the living as a revolutionary duty.
